text:
maya: Heads-up: need a k6 traffic replay for EU soak tomorrow 09:00 UTC. We saw sticky-session failures during last run; need profiling + heapdump when it happens. Can infra folks help set up flamegraphs?

jonas: I can own the replay orchestration. Which snapshot and traces do you want to replay?

maya: Use snapshot eu-prod-2026-03-15-21z (S3 path s3://rwdn-replays/eu/20260315.tar.gz). Target qps=1800, 50% ramp 10m, 2h steady.

sam: Heads up: last time the KV cache thrashed at ~1200 qps, causing 500s from runtime. Are we enabling continuous batching?

maya: Yes enable batching=auto and prefix_cache=true. Also please enable kv cache metrics + per-shard flameprof.

linda: For profiling: I can add flameprof agent and increase pprof sampling to 200hz. Will need a quick canary before full soak.

den a: @infra-bot schedule replay for 2026-03-18T09:00Z on eu1 with tags: soak, sticky-debug

infra-bot: Scheduled replay job: id=r-replay-4382, start=2026-03-18T09:00Z, config: qps=1800, ramp=10m, duration=2h, snapshot=eu-prod-20260315. Notifying on this thread.

jonas: I'll run a 15m canary at 09:00 then promote to full after green checks. Ping me when canary starts.

maya: Canary checks: 1) 95th < 250ms 2) error rate <0.2% 3) no per-node OOMs. If fail, rollback to smaller qps=800 and capture heapdump.

sam: What’s the heapdump trigger? auto on OOM or manual?

linda: I'll add an endpoint to trigger heapdump via admin API: POST /admin/debug/heapdump -> returns s3 link. I'll push PR now.

maya: PR pls @jonas for quick review. Also need flamegraph upload to /artifacts/replays/eu/r-replay-4382/ by default.

jonas: On it, will review in 20m.

linda: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2942 Added pprof 200hz + heapdump trigger + flameprof agent. Notes in commit.

sam: :eyes: quick question — will enabling 200hz increase CPU overhead a lot for long soak?

linda: Expect ~6-8% CPU. We can disable in steady if overhead >10% during canary.

den a: Ops: remember to set rollout policy to canary->full and fallback model to small-quant if runtime degrades.

maya: Good call. Also add an alert: replay/kvcache/miss_rate > 5% for 5m -> pager to eng-runtime oncall.

infra-bot: Alert rule created: replay/kvcache/miss_rate > 5% 5m. Pager: #eng-oncall.

jonas: I'll post the k6 script and replay steps in the job notes. Uploading now.

maya: If canary passes, we should schedule a focused 30m profiler run capturing flamegraphs every 5m.

sam: I'll coordinate with perf to analyze the flamegraphs. Assign me as owner for analysis.

maya: Thanks all. TL;DR: canary @09:00, qps1800, snapshot eu-prod..., PR merged, flameprof+heapdump ready, alerts set. Keep thread for play-by-play.

infra-bot: Replay r-replay-4382 status: queued -> canary_running (09:00:12 UTC).

jonas: Canary started. Logs: container-12 CPU spikes 90% at 09:06, but 95th=230ms, errors 0.05%.

sam: Saw GC spikes in flamegraph, uploading sample: s3://rwdn-artifacts/replays/eu/r-replay-4382/flame-09-06.svg

maya: Nice. Let's go full at 09:20 if no OOMs.

infra-bot: Replay r-replay-4382 promoted to full at 09:21:03 UTC.

jonas: Full running. Monitoring k6 stats in job page.

linda: Heapdump trigger endpoint returned link: s3://rwdn-artifacts/replays/eu/r-replay-4382/heapdump-09-45.hprof (triggered at 09:45 due to OOM in node-7).

sam: I'll grab heapdump and run HeapHero, will post findings in ~45m.

maya: Solid. If anyone sees regressions pls post immediate callouts. Otherwise I'll close thread after postmortem notes tomorrow.
